layout.kappung.zeichen: {kanal}: no grid, no table — plain text, {zeichen} characters
layout.kappung.anzahl_zu_breit: {kanal}: {anzahl} {subjekt} · too wide — max {max}, further forward = safer
layout.kappung.spalten_zu_breit.one: {kanal}: {count} column (label + {subjekt}) · too wide — max {max}, further forward = safer
layout.kappung.spalten_zu_breit.other: {kanal}: {count} columns (label + {subjekt}) · too wide — max {max}, further forward = safer
layout.hinweis.kanal_abwahl: A channel shows at most what is selected in the base selection. Anything missing there appears in no channel.
layout.korridor.titel_route: Tell me which values suit you
layout.korridor.titel_vergleich: Tell me which values are ideal for you
layout.korridor.einleitung_route: One target range per metric sets which values you still accept on the trip. Values within the range are highlighted in the briefing. You set warnings between briefings in the Alerts tab.
layout.korridor.einleitung_vergleich: One target range per metric sets your ideal range. Values within the range are marked green per location in the briefing — no score, no ranking, just a reading aid.
layout.korridor.zusatz_fehlt: Additional metrics could not be loaded — the standard metrics are available to choose from.
layout.korridor.legende_titel: How to read a target range
layout.korridor.pflicht: At least one limit (From or To) is required: {metriken}
layout.korridor.neutral: no score · no rank · target ranges only mark, they do not sort
layout.ausgabe.sms_hinweis: SMS has at most 140 characters. Order: top = more important. Anything that no longer fits the budget is left out automatically.
layout.ausgabe.leer: No metrics — add some from “Not in the briefing”.
layout.ausgabe.spalten_eyebrow: In the briefing as a column
layout.ausgabe.spalten_hinweis: One table column per metric. Order = left to right.
layout.ausgabe.detail_eyebrow: In the briefing as a detail
layout.ausgabe.detail_hinweis: Shown as a compact line directly below the table.
layout.mail_inhalt.kompakt_hinweis: In compact mode, the metrics overview + outlook are always shown. The content blocks below are disabled.
layout.mail_inhalt.etappen_kennzahlen_te: Distance, ascent/descent and maximum altitude of the stage as a number grid.
layout.mail_inhalt.quick_take_text: Coloured keyword pills at the top, e.g. “Dry”, “Windy”.
layout.mail_inhalt.metriken_ueberblick_t: Replaces quick-take chips and the daily summary with one coloured pill per active metric.
layout.mail_inhalt.ausblick_text: Weather pattern header, next stages and forecast confidence at the end of the email.
layout.mail_inhalt.grosswetterlage_text: Assessment of weather stability, e.g. “stable high pressure”.
layout.mail_inhalt.zusammenfassung_text: Short text with the day's main weather highlights.
layout.mail_inhalt.vortag_vergleich_text: Today's weather compared with yesterday as a short line in the briefing.
layout.gpx.import_text: Upload a GPX file to create a stage and a trip from it.
layout.gpx.fehler_hochladen: Failed to upload the GPX file.
layout.gpx.fehler_name: Trip name must contain at least one letter or number.
